### Implemented evidence criteria

Evidence criteria used for variant classification in CPSR (pole *P*: pathogenic support, *B*: benign support; *score*: contribution to the pathogenicity score).

```{r acmg_evidence_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

acmg_criteria_pdf <- cpsr::acmg[["evidence_codes"]] |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$pathogenicity_pole, dplyr::desc(abs(.data$path_score))) |>
  dplyr::select(
    `Evidence code` = "cpsr_evidence_code",
    Pole = "pathogenicity_pole",
    Category = "category_long",
    Description = "description",
    Score = "path_score") |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character))

acmg_criteria_pdf |>
  tinytable::tt(width = c(1.5, 0.5, 1.7, 5.2, 0.6)) |>
  tinytable::format_tt(escape = TRUE) |>
  cpsr:::style_tt_header_pdf() |>
  ## evidence codes colored by pole (as in the HTML report)
  tinytable::style_tt(
    i = which(acmg_criteria_pdf$Pole == "P"), j = 1,
    background = "#9E0142", color = "white", bold = TRUE) |>
  tinytable::style_tt(
    i = which(acmg_criteria_pdf$Pole == "B"), j = 1,
    background = "#077009", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

### Calibration of classification thresholds

`r cpsr:::doc_note_pdf(cpsr::classification_thresholds_intro_doc_note())`

```{r classification_plot_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

## Typst reads images from the render directory only
threshold_plot_pdf <- "cpsr_classification_score_thresholds.png"
invisible(file.copy(
  system.file("extdata", "CPSR_classification_score_thresholds.png",
              package = "cpsr"),
  threshold_plot_pdf, overwrite = TRUE))
```

![](cpsr_classification_score_thresholds.png){width=100%}

The following thresholds are currently used to assign classifications based on pathogenicity scores:

```{r score2tier_pdf}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

cpsr::acmg[["score2tier"]] |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    CPSR_PATHOGENICITY_SCORE = stringr::str_replace_all(
      .data$CPSR_PATHOGENICITY_SCORE, "</?b>", ""),
    ## classifications as colored pills (as in the HTML report)
    CPSR_CLASSIFICATION = cpsr:::classification_pill_pdf(
      .data$CPSR_CLASSIFICATION)) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `Classification` = "CPSR_CLASSIFICATION",
    `Pathogenicity score` = "CPSR_PATHOGENICITY_SCORE") |>
  tinytable::tt(width = c(0.5, 0.5)) |>
  tinytable::format_tt(j = 2, escape = TRUE) |>
  cpsr:::style_tt_header_pdf()
```
